title: Multi-Task Learning for Non-Canonical Phoneme Recognition via Articulatory Feature Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2608.22273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pathological and more broadly non-canonical speech present significant challenges for automatic phoneme recognition due to systematic deviations from canonical pronunciation and limited availability of labeled clinical speech data. Existing phoneme recognition systems are typically trained on canonical speech and treat phonemes as atomic categorical labels, limiting their ability to detect structured articulatory errors common in speech disorders and accents. In this work, we introduce a linguistically structured approach to non-canonical phoneme recognition that decomposes phoneme prediction into articulatory feature dimensions such as manner, place, and voicing. translated_title: 非规范音素识别中的多任务学习：基于发音特征分解
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22273v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：病理性和更广泛的非规范性语音，由于与规范发音的系统性偏差以及标记临床语音数据的有限可用性，给自动音素识别带来了重大挑战。现有的音素识别系统通常在规范性语音上训练，并将音素视为原子类别标签，这限制了它们检测语音障碍和口音中常见结构发音错误的能力。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种语言结构化的非规范音素识别方法，该方法将音素预测分解为发音特征维度，如发音方式、发音部位和浊音性。我们使用一种层次化多任务学习架构来实现这一表述，其中特定任务的发音特征头学习特征级表示，随后通过基于交叉注意力的融合模块集成，以产生音素预测。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通过发音特征分解和层次化多任务学习架构，结合交叉注意力融合模块，来改进非规范语音中音素识别的方法，有效应对发音偏差和数据稀缺问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a linguistically structured approach to non-canonical phoneme recognition using articulatory feature decomposition and a hierarchical multi-task learning architecture with cross-attention fusion, addressing pronunciation deviations and data scarcity.
